summary: Verified the face match fix end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_face_match.py (pytest) covering (a) services.face_match_service.compare_faces directly with the 3 fixture faces p1/p2/p3 and (b) the admin re-check endpoint POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/face-match via the live backend. 12/12 tests passed on first run.
critical_code_review_comments: face_embed._models() is lazily initialised but not re-entrant across threads — the compare() path holds _lock so this is safe for current usage; keep the lock if the service is ever moved to a thread-pool.

face_match_service._load_bytes always returns (bytes, mime) for data: URIs but may return None (not a tuple) for failed http/file fetches — current callers short-circuit with `not a or not b`, which works but a tuple-return contract would be cleaner.
Thresholds MATCH_MIN=0.42 / MISMATCH_MAX=0.30 look reasonable and are stricter than SFace's official 0.363 — borderline gap (0.30-0.42) correctly falls back to LLM or 'unverified'.
seed_data_creation: End-to-end test temporarily sets partner_profiles.basic.live_photo_url and bookings.checkin.selfie_url for the first eligible booking, then restores the original values on test completion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend starts cleanly with opencv-python-headless==5.0.0.93; YuNet + SFace ONNX models present at /app/backend/ml_models. Direct service tests: different pairs p1-p2, p1-p3, p2-p3 → mismatch; same-person augmentations (identity, +40 brightness, 12° rotation, 1/3 downscale+q40 jpeg, hflip) all pass (hflip is allowed to come back as match OR unverified since SFace is not strictly flip-invariant — in this run it matched). No-face selfie → mismatch with reason 'No clear face found in the check-in selfie'; no-face KYC → unverified. End-to-end admin re-check with p2 KYC vs p3 selfie returned status=mismatch, booking.face_mismatch=true, and a face_mismatch notification row was created in db.notifications; swapping selfie to p2 returned match and face_mismatch=false. The vision LLM tie-breaker was never reached in these tests (all cases fell on the strict side of the thresholds), which matches the agent note that vision AI isn't configured locally.
rca of the issue: Original bug: compare_faces relied solely on a vision LLM prompt that explicitly asked the model to ignore beard/hair changes, so cross-identity selfies were being approved. Fix verified: compare_faces now computes YuNet-detected + SFace-embedded cosine similarity first and returns a deterministic mismatch for different people (p1/p2/p3 scores well below 0.30), only falling back to the vision LLM for borderline [0.30, 0.42) scores. Reproduction and mitigation covered by test_different_people_mismatch and test_admin_recheck_end_to_end.
